steps.text: Talk to Kangai Mau in the Brimhaven food store.
choices: Ok, I will get it back.

steps.text: Travel to the GPDT depot in Ardougne and investigate the most northeastern crate for a label.
Use the label on the highlighted crate.
Talk to a nearby GPDT employee.
choices: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

steps.text: Talk to Wizard Cromperty in north east Ardougne.
choices: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

steps.text: Work out and enter the password for the door to the west.
Try and open the door to the west. The password is 'KURT', (K=10 right, U=6 left, R=9 left, T=7 left)
FIRST Right-click 'Investigate' the stairs to disable a trap, then climb the stairs.
Open the chest on the top floor and search it for the totem.
Return to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven.
Click the highlighted arrows to move the slots to the solution 'KURT'.
